verdict.rationale: cubic documents an interactive-comments feature. Developers can tag @cubic-dev-ai or reply to its existing PR comments to ask questions, trigger reviews, and request fixes, and replies to review comments can ask for clarification. Fix commands push code to the PR branch. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of in-thread conversational answers, and documentation of how much context those replies use (the codebase-aware AI chat evidence comes from an archived sidebar feature, not the PR thread).

support.subject: As a developer, I reply to the reviewer in the PR thread to ask questions, get explanations, or issue commands — and it answers in context

citations.quote: Interact with cubic in PR comments to ask questions, trigger reviews, and fix issues. You can tag `@cubic-dev-ai` directly, or reply to cubic's existing comments to continue the conversation.
Reply to a review comment to ask for clarification
cubic generates the fix and pushes it to your PR branch.
